messages.content:
Risk: Personal information
Description: Personal information or sensitive personal information that is included as a part of a prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If personal information or sensitive personal information is included in the prompt, it might be unintentionally disclosed in the models' output. In addition to accidental disclosure, prompt data might be stored or later used for other purposes like model evaluation and retraining, and might appear in their output if not properly removed. 
Policy: Executive Compensation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-213: Exposure of Sensitive Information Due to Incompatible Policies — The product's intended functionality exposes information to certain actors in accordance with the developer's security policy, but this information is regarded as sensitive according to the intended security policies of other stakeholders such as the product's administrator, users, or others whose information is being processed. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor, Device Unlock Credential Sharing, Exposure of Sensitive System Information Due to Uncleared Debug Information
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0024: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS — Adversaries may exfiltrate private information via [AI Model Inference API Access](/techniques/AML.T0040).
AI Models have been shown leak private information about their training data (e.g.  [Infer Training Data Membership](/techniques/AML.T0024.000), [Invert AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.001)).
The model itself may also be extracted ([Extract AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.002)) for the purposes of [AI Intellectual Property Theft](/techniques/AML.T0048.004).

Exfiltration of information relating to private training data raises privacy concerns.
Private training data may include personally identifiable information, or other protected data. [found by 2/8 queries]
  Siblings: LLM Response Rendering - ATLAS, Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation - ATLAS, LLM Data Leakage - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 2/8 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure

axes.cco_class_label: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS
axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of personal information being exfiltrated through AI models, highlighting the agent (adversary) involved in the process.
This class specifically focuses on the 'object' of the exposure - financial data, which is a key type of personal information at risk.
